paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Headline result: g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1 from the R2 (AGB/HB) parameter of globular clusters using the semiconvective mixing scheme (abstract and Sec. 3.2); constraint defined where predictions fall below the observed 95% confidence interval. The excluded region in Fig. 1 ('R2', purple/darkviolet) was extracted from the vector PDF (Figures/Intro/AxionPhoton_final_updated.pdf in the e-print): it is a mass-independent rectangle with lower edge at g = 4.72e-11 GeV^-1 (matching the quoted 0.47e-10), spanning the full plotted mass range 1e-8 to 10 eV, so the limit is reported as a flat line over that range. The alternative 'R2 (asteroseismology)' curve at 0.34e-10 GeV^-1 (predictive-mixing scheme, violet/pink) was NOT used, as the paper presents 0.47e-10 as its conservative main constraint. Stellar cooling bound: no dark-matter density assumption, no rescaling applied.
